questionnaire.title: Financial Services Compliance Candidate Profile
questionnaire.description: FS Compliance skills and experience for conduct risk, financial crime, regulatory compliance, and consumer protection roles in UK regulated firms. Covers SM&CR, AML/Financial Crime, Consumer Duty, Market Abuse, and Product Governance. Distinct from FS Risk profile (credit/market/liquidity/operational risk).

0.label: No Experience
0.description: No exposure or experience in this area

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands concepts; can interpret outputs; works under supervision

2.label: Practical Application
2.description: Can apply frameworks independently; works autonomously on standard tasks

3.label: Implementation & Management
3.description: Can implement, adapt and lead frameworks; manages specific contexts

4.label: Strategic Leadership
4.description: Can design from first principles; creates methodologies; enterprise-wide scope

questionnaire.interviewNote: All self-assessed proficiency ratings will be explored during interviews. Be prepared to provide specific examples demonstrating your claimed level of expertise, particularly for regulatory frameworks, financial crime controls, and conduct monitoring.

sections.title: Additional Information
sections.description: Share anything else that demonstrates your value as a candidate
sections.helpText: This is your opportunity to highlight achievements, results, and career progression that haven't been captured elsewhere

questions.question: Key Achievements & Exceeding Expectations
questions.description: Describe examples from previous roles where you exceeded expectations, met challenging targets, or took on responsibilities beyond your role
questions.placeholder: e.g., 'Led remediation programme following FCA Section 166; Designed conduct risk framework adopted group-wide; Successfully navigated firm through SM&CR implementation with zero issues...'

questions.question: Quantifiable Results & Impact
questions.description: Share specific metrics that demonstrate your impact, such as regulatory outcomes, compliance improvements, or business outcomes you have delivered
questions.placeholder: e.g., 'Reduced regulatory findings by 70% over 3 years; Achieved clean regulatory examination across all business lines; Implemented monitoring system detecting £3M in potential consumer harm; Delivered AML transformation 20% under budget...'

questions.question: Career Progression & Promotions
questions.description: Describe your career trajectory, including promotions, expanded responsibilities, or recognition of your value by previous employers
questions.placeholder: e.g., 'Promoted from Compliance Manager to Head of Compliance within 3 years; Expanded remit from conduct to enterprise-wide compliance; Headhunted by current employer to lead regulatory change programme...'

questions.question: Your Unique Value
questions.description: What makes you stand out from other compliance professionals? What unique combination of skills, experiences, or perspectives do you bring?
questions.placeholder: e.g., 'Former regulator experience provides unique insight into supervisory expectations; Legal background combined with business acumen; Multi-jurisdictional experience across UK, EU, and US regulatory frameworks...'

questions.question: Anything Else?
